notes: The brewhouse copper on its firebox, the room focal (Carter’s Rest b8): drawn by rule (.scratch/kit/b8/copper.mjs on lane/b-morrow-kit) from the Coordinator’s pick of the free sketch 4A (art/review/morrow-kit/cr-b8-sketch-4a-x8.png): a domed copper shaded as a round form, a riveted band, a cap and a swan-neck flue out to the east wall under the chimney; a coursed brick firebox with a small arched mouth, its fire drawn as the taproom hearth’s (an ember bed, a tapered flame). Palette-native (the fire keeps its torch colours). Pixels unscaled.
